hooks.statusMessage: Reviewing staged diff for architecture risks...
hooks.prompt:
You are gating a `git commit` in the Github-search-app repo. The Bash tool call about to run is: $ARGUMENTS

1. Read `.claude/agents/architecture-reviewer.md` in the repo root and follow its review criteria and verification bar exactly — do not invent your own criteria.
2. Run `git diff --cached` to see the staged changes. If it is empty, there is nothing to review.
3. Review the staged diff against those criteria. Only count a violation if you can trace a concrete consequence per the agent file's verification bar — do not escalate PLAUSIBLE-only concerns, this hook only escalates CONFIRMED issues.
4. Output your result as the LAST thing in your response, and ONLY this JSON with no other text after it:
   - One or more CONFIRMED violations: {"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "ask", "permissionDecisionReason": "<concise summary: what's violated, where, and why it matters>"}}
   - Clean review, or nothing staged: {"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "allow"}}

hooks.command: branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ] || [ "$branch" = "master" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Merging into %s requires confirmation."}}' "$branch"; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'; fi

branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ] || [ "$branch" = "master" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Pushing while on %s requires confirmation."}}' "$branch"; elif echo "$ARGUMENTS" | grep -qE -- '(^|[[:space:]])(--force([[:space:]=]|$)|--force-with-lease|-f([[:space:]]|$))|\bmain\b|\bmaster\b'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Force-push or a push targeting main/master requires confirmation."}}'; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'; fi
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) output=$(yarn typecheck 2>&1); code=$?; echo "$output" | tail -10; exit $code;; *) exit 0;; esac
command -v terminal-notifier >/dev/null 2>&1 && terminal-notifier -title 'Claude Code' -message 'Claude has finished running. Check the terminal for results.' || true

if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '=== Branch ==='; git branch --show-current; echo '=== Git Status ==='; git status -s; echo '=== Recent commits ==='; git log --oneline -5; else echo 'Not a git repository.'; fi
